# NEW 2026-11-18 round 3 N2 casus belli (oe_tcb_). Generated by gen_round3_cb.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Location scope. A former province (gen_territory_outer.py: var:oe_tw_former_province) that has left Byzantium
# (var:oe_tw_former_lost) and is held by another country.
oe_tcb_reclaimable = {
    has_variable = oe_tw_former_province
    has_variable = oe_tw_former_lost
    NOT = { owner ?= { tag = BYZ } }
}
# Country scope. Byzantium or a country under it (the Byzantine bloc).
oe_tcb_bloc = {
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        AND = { exists = c:BYZ is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ }
    }
}
# Country scope: root = BYZ, scope:target = the country the casus belli is for. The target is outside the bloc and
# holds at least one lost former province. BYZ var oe_tcb_open is a cheap gate kept by oe_tcb_recount.
oe_tcb_can_reclaim = {
    tag = BYZ
    has_variable = oe_tcb_open
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:target }
        scope:target = {
            NOT = { oe_tcb_bloc = yes }
            any_owned_location = { oe_tcb_reclaimable = yes }
        }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
